terminal_claim_rules.MODEL_PARTIAL_CHAIN_ONLY: The prospective endpoint passes but its same-bank bridge does not; retain endpoint and independent readout claims but do not join them into a serial mediator chain.
terminal_claim_rules.PROSPECTIVE_BANK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUPPORTED: The prospective endpoint does not pass; do not open its bridge and retain only immutable historical evidence.
terminal_claim_rules.CROSS_MODEL_GENERALITY: Allowed only if both Qwen3-8B and Gemma4-E4B independently satisfy MODEL_FULL_CHAIN_CONFIRMED.

exhaustion_rule: The prospectively frozen full-span bridge is the final allowed same-bank geometry branch. A further head, layer, cut, position or geometry search requires a new outcome-blind preregistration and cannot alter this ledger.
interpretation_boundary: A confirmed chain establishes a time-ordered causal route through a sufficient terminal hidden state and model-specific answer readout. It does not establish natural-effect mediation, a unique minimal circuit, or a one-dimensional scalar count code.
